case_name: State By Jnanabharathi vs For The Offences Punishable ...

parties.respondent_defendant: Muralidhar, Sarojamma, Smt.Meenakshi, Smt.Savitha, Ashwathnarayana, C.N.Siddalinga @ Siddaraju

facts_of_case: CW.1 and accused No.1 marriage solemnized as per Hindu customs. Accused persons demanded CW.4 for cash of Rs.50,000/- and one gold ring. After the marriage, CW.1 used to stay with accused persons.

legal_principles.principle: Caste customary practices do not override the rights of a spouse.
legal_principles.held: There is no intimacy between CW.1 and accused No.1.
cited_cases: State By Jnanabharathi vs For The Offences Punishable ... on 29 May, 2023

legal_principles.principle: A spouse has the right to a separate house.
legal_principles.held: Accused No.1 made separate house at Kalyana nagara, on the demand made by Cw.1.
cited_cases: State By Jnanabharathi vs For The Offences Punishable ... on 29 May, 2023

outcome.final_order: The accused pleaded not guilty and were acquitted.

use_for_drafting: responding to a domestic violence complaint
appealing an acquittal in a dowry prohibition case
